lines.en: Hello.
Today I am presenting the song “I’m Still Standing” by Elton John.
I chose this song because it is fun, energetic, and easy to remember.
I also like the message of the song.
The song is about being strong after a difficult time.
First, look at the colours in the video.
The video has many bright colours.
We can see blue sky, yellow sun, colourful clothes, and the beach.
I think the bright colours make the video feel happy and full of energy.
The song is about a difficult relationship, but the video does not look sad.
The second thing is Elton John’s clothes and glasses.
He wears many different clothes and funny, colourful glasses.
He looks confident and he has a lot of energy.
I think this shows that he is happy to be himself.
He does not want to hide.
The mood of the video is positive, happy, and strong.
The message is that a person can have a difficult time, but they can get better and move on.
In the video, Elton John is dancing, smiling, and having fun.
He wants to show: “I had a difficult time, but I am still here. I am strong, and I can enjoy my life.”
That is why I think “I’m Still Standing” is a positive and powerful song.
